hosts.next_evidence_opportunity: Review the ARexx guide and door lifecycle documentation for host command dispatch and normal script completion.
Locate an AmiExpress node-action or status-text setter beyond the public AEDoor calls already reviewed.
Review bbs_close for normal completion and bbs_open/ExternInfo for current-caller identity.
Seek host-specific wrapper documentation; the public library itself contains only terminal I/O and lifecycle cleanup.
Check developer-only DoorPort commands for a node action-string setter distinct from account status.
Find a primary MAXs command table defining remaining-time fields and host-visible activity mutation.
Research the underlying MAXs protocol for a node activity-description setter not exposed by UCDoor.
Locate and catalog a WWBBS ARexx programmer reference or protocol definition before reviewing individual operations.
Locate and catalog a Zeus door SDK or protocol specification before reviewing individual operations.
